learnings: Tool errors (API failures, parsing errors) should not produce inconclusive verdicts when substantive security analysis is complete for critical files like PKGBUILD
Distinguish between 'file could not be analyzed due to tool error' and 'file has security concerns' in verdict aggregation
When low-risk metadata files (.gitignore, .nvchecker.toml) fail analysis but PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO are successfully analyzed and found safe, the overall verdict should reflect the successful analysis
Implement retry logic or fallback models for transient API errors to reduce inconclusive results
